name: ACL Rolling Review (October 2026 cycle; long papers)

style.why: CFP: authors may not modify the style files; non-conforming submissions are rejected without review

required.why: CFP: papers without a Limitations section "will be desk rejected"
required.fix: \section*{Limitations} after the conclusion, before the references (not counted)

llm_disclosure.where: Responsible NLP Checklist (submission form); details in the Acknowledgements
llm_disclosure.why: CFP: use of AI for writing or coding, and its scope, must be disclosed

notes: Short papers: 4 pages (5 camera-ready): run with --page-limit 4
Responsible NLP Checklist is part of the submission form: incorrect or incomplete answers can be desk-rejected
acl.sty hash is the master branch as of 2025-08-19 (last commit touching the file)
